**Round 335 verdict: PASS.** I found no bugs. `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are true. The perf run, the cross-lane probe and the auth check all ran in real Chromium.

- **Scope:** only the 4 granted files changed. `app/` and `perf/lib/` are untouched, and the protected files are intact (11/11). The 167 old budget rows are unchanged, and the 26 new rows are all `record`.
- **Perf run:** I ran the production perf spec on its own, on a scratch copy of A's tree.
  - It returned rc 0 with 193 rows and no failures, and all 36 asserts passed.
  - All 121 old non-wallclock rows are equal to round 334, and 18 rows are new.
  - `interact.harness.drag-lane-live` and its `.6x` copy read 1 in every pass.
- **Premise:** a cross-lane move costs about 2.3 times a same-lane move per pointer move (96.545 vs 41.25 components, at 1× and 6×, stopped and playing). The new deterministic rows are identical across passes. They are saved in `lane-rows.txt` as the baseline for c3-ii.
- **Mutants:** MU-LANE-NO-CROSS and my own MU-C335-NO-BACK each turn the liveness row to 0. The failures name conditions (a), and (b) and (c). The scratch spec was restored.
- **Cross-lane probe:** at 1440×900 the app-tree and HEAD results match each other and B's recorded result. The provider re-renders on every cross-lane move.
- **Auth:** at 1440×900 and 1280×720 in fresh anonymous contexts, `/studio-lab` opens the demo and `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required". `/api/studio-token` returns 401 with no header, and the fake-bearer and bare requests return no token. Premium auth is not bypassed.
- **Docs and unit tests:** docs 232 and 168 match the task. The perf-lib report tests pass 34/34.
- **Retry:** the first auth and HEAD-probe attempts timed out on a cold dev server and passed when re-run. I don't count that as an app finding.

I agree with A that its own Low (`A-R335-REVIEW-WHOLE-NOTE`) goes to `deferred_low_polish`.

Gate rows (full vitest, build, Biome, typecheck, verify, e2e smoke) are not claimed. This round has no visible change, so no screenshots or Ableton comparison apply.
